Bags of three loaves.

parameters.value: one bag per holder per evening
parameters.rationale: A holder opens the app once an evening and buys at most one bag.

parameters.value: a bag uses 3 loaves of the weekly allowance
parameters.rationale: A holder with fewer than 3 loaves left in the week cannot buy a bag. A holder whose allowance is 2 can never buy one. The same loaf cap applies to A and C.
The brief leaves B's platform commission out.

parameters.value: criee.engine Market + run_until, in-memory signed ledger
parameters.rationale: Policy C is the real clearing engine, not a re-implementation. Its weekly match cap counts loaves, because every match is one loaf.
Starts at list price, reaches the floor at 80 percent of the window (about 19:02), then holds it until 19:10.
Kept at 0.30 x list in every run. Leftovers are sunk cost, so the floor is not set from unit cost.
Pickup window of each clock lot.

parameters.value: wish paused after its match, resumed next morning
parameters.rationale: The engine has no per-evening cap, so the sim pauses a holder's wish after a match (the engine's own pause state) so the holder cannot buy from a second bakery that evening. Holders at their weekly cap stay paused for the rest of the week.
The engine breaks same-minute ties by listing order, so the order is shuffled each evening.

parameters.value: a lot closes the moment it sells out
parameters.rationale: The engine would keep emitting empty ticks until 19:10. No fill can happen after sell-out, so allocations are unchanged; checked against the unshortened run on four seed and adoption pairs.
A match is a no-show when a hash of the seed and match id falls in the lowest 8 percent, so each seed has a fixed set of no-shows.

parameters.value: captured then fully refunded at match time
parameters.rationale: A no-show's unit never returns to the clock, its buyer's weekly match still counts, and the seller gets zero revenue. This is the conservative treatment the brief asks for.
Applied to policy C only. Policies A and B carry no fee in the model.

parameters.unit: probability per holder per bakery in radius per evening
parameters.rationale: Attention-parity run only: A's walk-by set to 1.0, so every holder in radius considers every shop every evening.
Attention-parity run only: B's app-open set to 1.0. C is unchanged, which isolates how much of the gap comes from standing wishes being always present versus from the clearing rule.
Seeds 0..9 at 3% adoption, with the same worlds as the headline run for those seeds.
Headline run: twenty seeds at the default adoption.
Sensitivity uses seeds 0..9; the 3% entry reuses the headline runs for those seeds.

parameters.value: Student-t 95% interval of the mean across seeds
parameters.rationale: Used for the figure whiskers and the shaded band. The sd is the sample sd (n-1).

parameters.value: min and max of the mean with one seed left out
parameters.rationale: Shows how much one seed can move the mean.

parameters.value: random.Random seeded from a string, per seed and per policy
parameters.rationale: Each policy has its own stream, so changing one policy cannot shift another.
